svg.title: The dragon's repeating four-pattern flight route
svg.desc: A circle, figure eight, opposite circle, and mirrored figure eight repeat. Low passes rise to about eight metres and peaks to eighteen. Arrows show direction; an altitude chart covers the complete sequence. This is the head target, not the physical dragon's trajectory.

g.text: Four Catmull–Rom patterns · 69.6 seconds including entry · then repeat
The head follows the target. Joints and inertia carry the body and tail; the camera keeps its viewing angle.
